responsibility: Provides the shared backend translation infrastructure for gfortran. It manages statement blocks, temporary variables, location mapping, expression evaluation helpers, predictiveness wrappers, and the top-level dispatch that turns resolved Fortran code into GENERIC/GIMPLE for functions, modules, and block data before handing it to the middle end.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the shared translation engine behind trans.h: statement-block creation, temporary-variable helpers, location mapping, expression evaluation helpers, branch prediction wrappers, wrapped init/cleanup blocks, and the central dispatch that drives executable-code, function, and module lowering. The header instead defines the common data structures, macros, enums, and declarations that all trans-* implementations use.
